# Election update: Wednesday, November 4 (morning)

## Bottom line
Democrats won control of both chambers, NPR, NBC News and CNN report ([NPR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNZVhrSEZna25zZzkxdEROS2w2MGkwWmdJTlY2Y3Z3ZWxnQ1MwVzV1YXlDVkdOZ3NOVE5KOXZaVnhBTlBaTlNVSVd4NjdIbklVVGRNYlhIN2NzN0pPNk52aVJpQ1NERFJwZnJLWlZ3MzdqN0VPbWZvcS1qQjNaQXUtUzJKUkc5bTJ4UWc?oc=5), [NBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE9HT01FMldrNmE3Z1pmR3lRYmxaMVhxNDN1MF9maXpIV1hiU2xLWnpuWURkeEFhXzVEMmdjR3dreFgyeWZxZDYxTVVxSWh4cUFGMkc4N3Bja2RzQm1KS2x3clhsR0I2WVR4WXVOTUNtRQ?oc=5), [CNN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOWXFCZ1pzSTJKRWV4cXhvRFVkWFk1MWI3dVdXeU5KUE10MDRTNk5FQmkzUnZtQmVzbXcxYm9ZNU1ScnFkV2czWHRLVHM0OTRGRTItbGVYU1A1ckVRUThYNHRmOUZITXE2eG1neHJzUzBQLVdhWmtxaWZFUFp2eFZzUQ?oc=5)). In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up this year, with Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled ([results table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). In the House, 210 of 435 races are marked called (D 141, R 69) in the Wikipedia results table, which lags AP. The networks' control call is ahead of that count ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). No seat rated safe has a count within 5 points so far; vote shares are not yet posted in the table.

## Called since the last update
- **Senate flips to Democrats (7):** Maine ([Troy Jackson unseated Susan Collins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1DNGdfNXVubERrcl9TTWxmTjNXalhhZ2Y3dGFqSHZpbTJHYUstMkZCc05rRFdMbkJidjQxREs4OEViOXlxRlVTTnhfV2tKdDRVYmwxR1pYempkT1ZoYUdWMEVVQXdDSVlvT3FTV1RsTUZwV3JLNVlj?oc=5)); Texas ([James Talarico won the open seat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBVYlQ3b0ZxTVR2NUdxWVZ6SnpWTDFHYTB4TTRqd2VGNWtMVWdyZnJDU2lMMF9nc2FtRWN4SDJwYzRxR0VhQUFSY2I2bHhjR2p5Sm9MdFZGNGxuMUY4RlRLamdLZVpSTW1yRXNSS2l0MUI1VmpCd2tz?oc=5)); Ohio special ([Sherrod Brown beat Sen. Jon Husted](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQbjVfQzFjOG5LTVV5RlVTWm9zS1VtSFBWYzN6YlVUMDBidGFuaF9uRWxJQ245R3JwZjZ3c1ZoNVF2UzdxbVE4R0gyUmxqYU1kb1ZSMG1qdXRoQ0RERnIyc2NndXcyUVlDOTN3WmRVbGc3TzlfLTFNU1J1NUF1d0ZvMg?oc=5)); Kansas ([Adam Hamilton beat Sen. Roger Marshall](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9VLXM4M0xvcmJZMFNweWd5SGQ5MGg5OE9hMFBqLTN0TE1GakUwSGhfZFhpYUVILXFrMGFHSVFVTVE5QkFxd3lMZWhqY05wT2xCazdrSnNIZFQyc21LOWdDV2g1SW5DS0tQUzJSWVEwOHlCRnBYUUtTQw?oc=5)); Iowa ([Josh Turek won the open seat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1DSHJvaDVLOWdwb2NCd2QzQkpkRnZBeEptWjRONFMtcU4zWkhzZGowbG9RV2EyOVZ3TldHTWJnWkJsVGw4U0hDWS04ak1URDdkVUd2NFBuX2hOR0hlTWM0MUVTcGNqOTZiMDUzZERFdXpXX1dOTVE?oc=5)); South Carolina ([Annie Andrews beat Sen. Darline Graham](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPVVdjMjRyMzN2S2RTc1poUU1zaXV1NjR6UGZzM1ZLcGVhUW81WkVWR0E2Wmt3QTMwOVpCNlQxa1JlMHBzLTFySnB1T3lSLXVzRWhOTUlINTZMNnFIUDZEZjBTTDVRaWxRYy1fZ25OdHlNSGY3TDQ1UUFwUm1vdkhtWU5ZNA?oc=5)); North Carolina ([Roy Cooper won the open seat](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Each is marked called in the [results table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections), following AP.
- **Senate holds:** Democrats held Michigan (El-Sayed, [NBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE5QbjdLR0lGd3lQNVlfWVMxT3ZCRG9aUUhORTJqOFdSUkJkTlp0V3FXQXpiay1WaElBMGI0MU1TUkRkbzZPVG5kQTduSy1XZlQxNjRjLVFjMFo3T1RaOV93UVp4QUw1a3RSWVJSUDFZcndTTWtCVmoxdHkzSQ?oc=5)), Minnesota and New Hampshire. - **House flips in competitive seats (18):** IA-01 (Christina Bohannan), IA-02 (Lindsay James), IA-03 (Sarah Trone Garriott), IN-05 (J. D. Ford), KY-06 (Zach Dembo), MO-02 (Fred Wellman), NC-09 (Richard Ojeda), NC-11 (Jamie Ager), NC-13 (Paul Barringer), NC-14 (Lakesha Womack), NE-02 (Denise Powell), NJ-02 (Zack Mullock), NJ-07 (Rebecca Bennett), PA-01 (Bob Harvie), PA-07 (Bob Brooks), PA-08 (Paige Cognetti), PA-10 (Janelle Stelson), TX-15 (Bobby Pulido) ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)).
- **Upsets in seats rated Likely R:** NC-09 (Ojeda over Hudson), NC-13 (Barringer over Knott), NC-14, IN-05 (J.D. Ford, [PBS](https://news.google.?oc=5)) and NJ-02 are marked called for Democrats ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)).
